claim: Vietnam's share of global Apple AirPods TWS assembly rose from 51% in 2024 to 64% in 2025, then eased to 62% in Q1 2026 as India gained share.
stance_target: speed of manufacturing diversification away from China
scope_conditions: AirPods TWS product category only, country-level assembly share
quoted_support: In 2025, Vietnam's share of global AirPods manufacturing increased from 51% in 2024 to 64% in 2025. However, in Q1 2026, the country lost some share to India manufacturing.

claim: China's share of global AirPods assembly fell from 49% in 2024 to 35% in 2025 and 34% in Q1 2026, even as China retains dominance in AirPods component/rare-earth supply (dysprosium, neodymium magnets).
stance_target: manufacturing diversification away from China is real but component-level dependence persists
scope_conditions: AirPods TWS assembly share; China retains upstream component dominance
quoted_support: China's assembly share declined from 49% in 2024 to 35% in 2025 and further to 34% in Q1 2026... The country still continues to dominate in terms of component ecosystem and rare earth material supply.

claim: India's share of global AirPods assembly grew from 1% in 2025 to 4% in Q1 2026, run through Foxconn Hyderabad with limited assembly lines but expanding.
quoted_support: Apple AirPods TWS manufacturing in India reached 4% of global shipments in Q1 2026, up from 1% in 2025... Foxconn Hyderabad remains the key manufacturing partner with limited assembly lines.
